items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: I’ve done an awful lot of shows there now over the years, you know either mixing or working alongside Jay Vicari who is the senior music mixer.

ctx.x: I’m wondering if, you know Saturday night when the show was over, you know, “Okay we’re off” if you and your colleagues sort of breathed this big sigh of relief?

You do on some of them you do. I mean I’ve done an awful lot of shows there now over the years, you know either mixing or working alongside Jay Vicari who is the senior music mixer. So we — there’s a lot under your belt but there’s also a phrase that I heard which I really like, it’s just tribal knowledge at this point. We’ve just done it a lot. And you know it’s the same way with all the record work I used to do that you just become very comfortable in your style of working. You always have this great sense of…
Yeah you’re actually getting a compliment by the fact that they’re not pointing something out, that this sounds good and so full speed ahead.
